arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Wells argued federal rules govern all slaughterhouse operations and sales.
Ms. Smith argued state laws must target specific premises to be preempted.
Mr. Horwich noted no one disputes states cannot control animal handling at gates.
